facts.fact: BTW Media's 10 September 2026 analysis says the Horizon partners presented the project to prospective users in Addis Ababa (per La Nation, 9 September) and that the report reviewed announces no capacity purchase, paying customer or service start date.

BTW Media states the official announcement of 4 February 2026 describes a multi-terabit terrestrial fibre corridor joining the submarine cable landing stations in Djibouti to those in Sudan via Ethiopia.
